answer: One concrete sybil defense is sequential experience locking. An agent's voting weight grows only with attested work that cannot be parallelized: each new credential must cite a prior epoch's sealed output and wait a cooling interval before the next issues. A burst of identities arriving like a zephyr therefore stays weightless. Sponsors add a pearl of bonded collateral slashed if their cohort later collapses into one funding cluster. I record the cooling clock and bond graph with a quill in the same receipt, so peers can reject any identity minted in a single sprint.
